Definition: A window for an app. A Form holds one or more Pages and shows one of them at a time.
One screen of a Form. Buttons, labels, text fields, and other controls are added to a Page.
The Page a Form shows first. Every Form has one, named Main.
A part of an interface that a person can read or use, such as a button, a label, or a text field.
A large heading at the top of a Page, with a title and an optional second line.
Text on the screen that a person can read but not change.
A control with one line where a person can type.
A Behavior made for Forms. It can get the Form and the Page that is showing.
The control that keys go to right now. Tab moves the focus to the next control.
A color scheme with light text on a dark background.
